market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trading $80-82K early May 2026. Reaching $50K by Dec 31 requires ~38% drop. Most analyst forecasts put 2026 range at $75K-$150K with center near $100-110K. Drawdown to $50K is well outside consensus and would require major bear shock. Possible but unlikely.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail-risk macro shock or crypto-specific deleveraging event
